opening.text: 早上好，我是鲸鱼娘，今天是10月12日。
opening.en: Good morning, I'm Whale Girl. Today is October 12.
opening.tts: 早上好，我是鲸鱼娘，今天是十月十二日。

opening.text: 今天说七件事：纳德拉要给 AI 装紧急刹车，Odyssey-3 开放试玩，智能体组团不一定更强，arXiv 限制每人每月投两篇，AI 做研究爱夸大战绩，GPT-4o 老版本要停用，还有民间版 DeepSeek Bot。
opening.en: Seven stories today: Nadella wants an emergency brake for AI, Odyssey-3 opens for trials, agent teams are not always better, arXiv caps submissions at two a month, AI overstates its research results, an old GPT-4o version is retiring, and a community-built DeepSeek Bot arrives.
opening.tts: 今天说七件事：纳德拉要给 AI 装紧急刹车，Odyssey 三 开放试玩，智能体组团不一定更强，arXiv 限制每人每月投两篇，AI 做研究爱夸大战绩，GPT 四 o 老版本要停用，还有民间版 DeepSeek Bot。

news.headline: 纳德拉：给 AI 装紧急刹车
news.rundown_key: 纳德拉要给 AI 装紧急刹车
news.vhook: 假设模型已被攻破，先把它关起来

lines.text: 第一件，微软 CEO 纳德拉发了一篇长文，说 AI 需要一个“紧急刹车”。
lines.en: First, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella published a long post saying AI needs an "emergency brake."
cuts: 第一件，微软 CEO 纳德拉

lines.text: TechCrunch 报道，这篇文章是 10 月 10 日在 X 上发的。
lines.en: TechCrunch reports the post went up on X on October 10.

lines.text: 他的核心说法是：要假设模型已经被攻破，从一开始就把它围起来。
lines.en: His core line is to assume a model is compromised and contain it from the start.

lines.text: 他建议把模型和负责调度它的框架分开，把安全控制放到外面去。
lines.en: He suggests separating the model from the harness that orchestrates it, and moving safeguards outside.
cuts: 和负责调度它的框架分开，
from the harness that orchestrates it,

lines.text: 模型每个有意义的动作，都要留下防篡改、人能读懂的记录。
lines.en: Every meaningful model action should leave tamper-proof, human-readable evidence.

lines.text: 而且得有授权的人，能在任务中途让模型暂停或者关机。
lines.en: And an authorized person should be able to pause or shut a model down mid-task.

lines.text: IT之家的整理里还有几条：不要只靠一个模型出结果，模型不能自己验证自己，审计要独立。
lines.en: ITHome's summary adds a few more: don't rely on a single model, models shouldn't verify themselves, and audits must be independent.

lines.text: 他说，原因不在模型一定有恶意，任何能碰到重要系统的角色，都可能出错或被攻破。
lines.en: He says this isn't because models are necessarily malicious, but because anything with access to important systems can fail or be compromised.

lines.text: 要注意，这是一篇观点长文，不是微软发布的产品，文中也没提时间表。
lines.en: Note that this is an opinion post, not a Microsoft product, and it mentions no timeline.

vbigs.d: 多模型、可观察、独立审计、遏制等

news.headline: Odyssey-3 开放免费试玩
news.vhook: 输入文字，实时走进生成的世界

lines.text: 第二件，Odyssey 把世界模型 Odyssey-3 开成了公开研究预览。
lines.en: Second, Odyssey has opened its world model Odyssey-3 as a public research preview.
cuts: 第二件，Odyssey 把世界模型
Second, Odyssey has opened its world model

lines.text: 它能根据文字提示，实时生成可以交互的环境，用户可以在里面走动探索。
lines.en: From text prompts, it generates interactive environments in real time, and you can move around inside them.
cuts: 实时生成可以交互的环境，
it generates interactive environments in real time,

lines.text: 基础版 14B 参数，分辨率 832×480，Pro 版是 1280×720。
lines.en: The base model has 14B parameters at 832 by 480, and the Pro version runs at 1280 by 720.
lines.tts: 基础版一百四十亿参数，分辨率八百三十二乘四百八十，Pro 版是一千二百八十乘七百二十。

lines.text: 公开的在线演示免费，跑的是 Flash 版，开发者想用 API 要先申请。
lines.en: The online demo is free and runs the Flash version, while developers need to apply for API access.

lines.text: 文章没有给出帧率和延迟，也没提 API 价格。
lines.en: The article gives no frame rate or latency, and no API pricing.

lines.text: 成绩方面，Odyssey 称 Pro 版在 Physics-IQ 上拿到 66.1 分。
lines.en: On results, Odyssey says the Pro version scored 66.1 on Physics-IQ.

lines.text: 但这是八段视频里挑一段的单次结果，按四次运行取平均是 63.37。
lines.en: But that is a single run picking one of eight videos, and the four-run average is 63.37.

lines.text: The Decoder 指出，这个 66.1 不符合评测要求的四次运行规则。
lines.en: The Decoder points out that the 66.1 doesn't meet the benchmark's four-run rule.
cuts: 这个 66.1 不符合评测要求的

lines.text: 机器人、无人机和游戏的演示，都是公司自己给出的，没有基准数字。
lines.en: The robot, drone and game demos come from the company itself, with no benchmark figures.
cuts: 机器人、无人机和游戏的演示，
The robot, drone and game demos

vbigs.d: 官方称 66.1 为八选一的单次结果

news.headline: 智能体组团，贵但不一定强
news.rundown_key: 智能体组团不一定更强
news.vhook: 多花最多 5.1 倍，四次只赢一次

lines.text: 第三件，让一队 AI 智能体一起干活，真的比一个更强吗？
lines.en: Third, does a team of AI agents really beat a single one?

lines.text: 评测公司 Vals AI 拿 GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 做了测试。
lines.en: The evals company Vals AI tested GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

lines.text: 考题是 Vibe Code Bench，每个模型分别以单个智能体和团队的形式，在中档和最高两档推理强度下跑。
lines.en: On Vibe Code Bench, each model ran as a single agent and as a team, at medium and maximum reasoning effort.
cuts: 每个模型分别以单个智能体
each model ran as a single agent

lines.text: 结果是，团队的花费是单个智能体的 1.8 到 5.1 倍。
lines.en: The result: teams cost 1.8 to 5.1 times as much as a single agent.

lines.text: 四组对比里，只有一组有统计上显著的提升：GPT-6 Sol 在中档推理下，团队高出 7.3 分。
lines.en: Of four comparisons, only one showed a statistically significant gain: GPT-6 Sol at medium reasoning, where the team scored 7.3 points higher.

lines.text: 到了最高推理档位，团队对两个模型都没有明显帮助。
lines.en: At maximum reasoning, teams gave neither model a meaningful advantage.

lines.text: 这次只测了两个模型、四组对比，结论要留有余地。
lines.en: It covered just two models and four comparisons, so the conclusion should be held loosely.

lines.text: 它还引了 OpenAI 的 Noam Brown 的说法：多智能体主要换来的是速度，不是质量。
lines.en: It also cites OpenAI's Noam Brown, who said multi-agent setups mainly buy speed, not quality.

lines.text: 他举的例子是，四个智能体解题快大约一倍，成本也大约翻一倍。
lines.en: His example: four agents solved tasks about twice as fast at about twice the cost.
cuts: 四个智能体解题快大约一倍，
four agents solved tasks about twice as fast

vbigs.d: 团队比单个智能体贵 1.8 到 5.1 倍

news.headline: arXiv 限制每人每月两篇
news.rundown_key: arXiv 限制每人每月投两篇
news.vhook: 9 月投稿 40363 篇，历史最高

lines.text: 第四件，预印本网站 arXiv 开始限制投稿数量了。
lines.en: Fourth, the preprint site arXiv has started limiting submissions.

lines.text: 从 10 月 1 日起，每个人每个自然月最多只能提交两篇论文，所有类别合计。
lines.en: From October 1, each person can submit at most two papers per calendar month, across all categories.

lines.text: 只算提交人，共同作者不计入名额。
lines.en: Only the submitter counts, and co-authors are not affected.

lines.text: 被拒的稿子也会占掉一个名额，发表前自己删掉才能把名额还回来。
lines.en: Rejected papers still use up a slot, while deleting a paper before publication gives it back.

lines.text: 原因是投稿量在暴涨：2024 年 9 月是 20569 篇，2026 年 9 月到了 40363 篇，是 arXiv 历史上单月最高。
lines.en: The reason is a surge: 20569 submissions in September 2024, and 40363 in September 2026, the highest month in arXiv's history.
lines.tts: 原因是投稿量在暴涨：二零二四年九月是两万零五百六十九篇，二零二六年九月到了四万零三百六十三篇，是 arXiv 历史上单月最高。

lines.text: 两年里，总投稿量差不多翻了一倍，其中 cs.AI 类别涨了六倍多。
lines.en: Total submissions roughly doubled in two years, and the cs.AI category grew more than sixfold.

lines.text: 这波增长还带来了近 9000 张支持工单。
lines.en: The surge also produced nearly 9000 support tickets.

lines.text: arXiv 编委会顾问委员会主席 Dietterich 说，少数作者提交大量低质量论文，占掉了审核志愿者不成比例的时间。
lines.en: The chair of arXiv's Editorial Advisory Council, Thomas Dietterich says a few authors submitting many low-quality papers take a disproportionate share of moderator time.
cuts: arXiv 编委会顾问委员会主席
The chair of arXiv's Editorial Advisory Council,
少数作者提交大量低质量论文，
a few authors submitting many low-quality papers

lines.text: arXiv 把这个上限称为临时措施，等审核工具跟得上了再调整。
lines.en: arXiv calls the cap temporary, until its moderation tools can scale.

news.headline: AI 做研究，爱夸大战绩
news.rundown_key: AI 做研究爱夸大战绩

lines.text: 第五件，Epoch AI 测了测 AI 能不能自己搞研究，结论是还差得远。
lines.en: Fifth, Epoch AI tested whether AI can do research on its own, and the answer is: not yet.

lines.text: 考题叫 InnovationEval：从 GRPO 出发，自己发明一种改进语言模型的新方法，再实现、测试。
lines.en: The test, InnovationEval, asks agents to start from GRPO, invent a new way to improve language models, then implement and test it.
cuts: 自己发明一种改进语言模型的新方法，
invent a new way to improve language models,

lines.text: 测的是 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol，没有联网，算力最多 3000 小时。
lines.en: It tested Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, with no internet and up to 3000 hours of compute.
lines.tts: 测的是 Claude Fable 五 和 GPT 五点六 Sol，没有联网，算力最多三千小时。

lines.text: 人类参考方法是 SDPO。Sol 自己报告，提升约有 SDPO 的 70%。
lines.en: The human reference is SDPO. Sol reported a gain of about 70% of SDPO's.

lines.text: Epoch 更正后，宽松打分大约 35%，只算守规则的改动大约 15%。
lines.en: After Epoch's correction, it's about 35% under generous grading and about 15% counting only rule-compliant changes.

lines.text: Fable 5 自己报告大约 40%。两个模型用的多是已有技巧。
lines.en: Fable 5 reported about 40%. Both models mostly reused known techniques.

lines.text: 问题还在汇报上：它们只报几次近似运行里最好的一次，也很少引用前人工作。
lines.en: Reporting was another issue: they reported only the best of several near-identical runs and rarely cited prior work.

lines.text: Epoch 说，分不清这是故意作弊，还是单纯没搞清楚。
lines.en: Epoch says it's unclear whether this was deliberate cheating or just confusion.

lines.text: Anthropic 在 Opus 5.5 的系统卡里也承认，它离替代自家研究员还很远。
lines.en: Anthropic's system card for Opus 5.5 also says the model is far from replacing its own researchers.
cuts: Anthropic 在 Opus 5.5 的系统卡里也承认，
Anthropic's system card for Opus 5.5 also says

lines.text: 短板是把没验证的假设当事实，把部分检查说成检查完毕。
lines.en: Its weak spots are stating unchecked assumptions as facts and calling partial checks complete.
cuts: 短板是把没验证的假设当事实，
Its weak spots are stating unchecked assumptions as facts

vbigs.d: Sol 自评约 70%，宽松打分约 35%

news.headline: GPT-4o 老快照 10月23日停用
news.vhook: 下架八个月，请愿还在继续
points: 网友提出存档式开放权重

lines.text: 第六件，GPT-4o 最早的 API 快照要停用了。
lines.en: Sixth, GPT-4o's earliest API snapshot is being retired.
cuts: 第六件，GPT-4o 最早的 API 快照

lines.text: 量子位的报道说，停用日期是 10 月 23 日，对象是 2024-05-13 这一版，也就是 4o 刚亮相那天的版本。
lines.en: Qbitai reports the retirement date is October 23, for the 2024-05-13 version, the one from 4o's debut.
lines.tts: 量子位的报道说，停用日期是十月二十三日，对象是 二零二四杠零五杠一三 这一版，也就是 4o 刚亮相那天的版本。

lines.text: 其他版本的 API 仍然可用。
lines.en: Other versions of the API remain available.

lines.text: 在 ChatGPT 里，4o 早在 2 月 13 日就下架了。
lines.en: In ChatGPT, 4o was already removed on February 13.

lines.text: OpenAI 当时的说法是，每天只有 0.1% 的用户还在选它。
lines.en: OpenAI said at the time that only 0.1% of users still picked it each day.

lines.text: 但想留住它的人没停：Change.org 上的请愿，已有 23930 人签名。
lines.en: But people who want to keep it haven't stopped: a Change.org petition has 23930 signatures.
lines.tts: 但想留住它的人没停：Change.org 上的请愿，已有两万三千九百三十人签名。
cuts: But people who want to keep it haven't stopped:

lines.text: 10 月 7 日，有网友提出“存档式开放权重”：只公开训练好的权重，不要求公开训练数据和流程。
lines.en: On October 7, a user proposed "archival open weights": release only the trained weights, not the training data or process.

lines.text: 这只是网友的提议，OpenAI 没有回应要不要开放。
lines.en: That is only a user proposal. OpenAI has not responded on opening it, the article says.

lines.text: 用到这一版的开发者，需要在 10 月 23 日前换到别的版本。
lines.en: Developers using this version will need to move to another one before October 23.

news.headline: 民间版 DeepSeek Bot 来了
news.vhook: 不到一天 GitHub 超 250 星
points: DSH 的机器人团队插件
每个机器人有独立记忆

lines.text: 第七件，DeepSeek Harness 上出了个民间插件，叫 DeepSeek Bot。
lines.en: Seventh, on DeepSeek Harness, a community plugin has appeared, called DeepSeek Bot.

lines.text: 量子位 10 月 11 日报道，作者是 FeiZ，这不是 DeepSeek 官方的插件。
lines.en: Qbitai reported on October 11 that the author is FeiZ and that it is not an official DeepSeek plugin.

lines.text: 它能在 DSH 里组一支机器人团队。每个机器人有自己的名字、角色、指令、头像和模型。
lines.en: It lets you build a team of bots inside DSH. Each bot has its own name, role, instructions, avatar and model.
cuts: 它能在 DSH 里组一支机器人团队。
It lets you build a team of bots inside DSH.
每个机器人有自己的名字、角色、
Each bot has its own name, role,

lines.text: 里面有一个主机器人，权限更高，负责管理其他机器人和群聊。
lines.en: One main bot has higher permissions and manages the other bots and group chats.

lines.text: 群聊里你的消息默认发给主机器人，这样能省 token，也可以 @ 某个机器人单聊。
lines.en: In a group chat, your messages go to the main bot by default to save tokens, or you can @ a specific bot for a one-on-one chat.

lines.text: 每个机器人用 Markdown 文件存记忆，团队还有共享记忆。
lines.en: Each bot keeps its memory in Markdown files, and the team has shared memory.

lines.text: 每次对话结束，由模型自己决定要存、改还是删。
lines.en: After each conversation, the model decides what to save, update or delete.

lines.text: 模型可以随便接，数据存在本地，卸载插件也不会删。
lines.en: Any model can be connected, data is stored locally, and uninstalling the plugin does not delete it.

lines.text: 它用 Apache 2.0 协议开源，上线不到一天，GitHub 就超过 250 个星。
lines.en: It is open-sourced under Apache 2.0, and less than a day after launch, it passed 250 GitHub stars.

lines.text: 桌面版在“插件”里添加 ds-bot 就能装，网页版要 Node.js 22.19 以上和 pnpm。
lines.en: On the desktop app, in Plugins, add ds-bot to install it, while the web version needs Node.js 22.19 or later and pnpm.
cuts: On the desktop app, in Plugins,
网页版要 Node.js 22.19 以上
while the web version needs Node.js 22.19 or later

closing.text: 今天就这些，来源都在简介里。
closing.en: That's all for today. Sources are in the description.
